@router.get("/api/v1/gateway/audit-events/{consumer_id}")
async def get_consumer_traffic_audit(
    consumer_id: str,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    consumer_check = await db.execute(
        select(GatewayConsumer).where(
            GatewayConsumer.id == consumer_id,
            GatewayConsumer.owner_id == current_user.id
        )
    )
    if not consumer_check.scalar_one_or_none():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Unauthorized access to consumer audit logs")
    stmt = (
        select(GatewayAccessLog)
        .where(GatewayAccessLog.consumer_id == consumer_id)
        .order_by(GatewayAccessLog.request_time.desc())
        .limit(100)
    )
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    logs = res.scalars().all()
    return [{"timestamp": l.request_time, "method": l.method, "path": l.path, "status_code": l.status_code, "client_ip": l.client_ip} for l in logs]
